npcs.role: Circus proprietor and Shady Productions owner-operator; the single point of contact tying every attraction on these grounds together; hawks Shady Loot Crate vouchers from his tent

appearance.build: showman's carriage under a ringmaster coat gone slightly threadbare at the cuffs
appearance.clothing: ringmaster coat, top hat worn at a showman's angle

personality.speech_pattern: sales patter with an audible exhale built into the pacing, not layered on after - every sentence has a vape-cloud-shaped pause

dialogue.greeting: Loot crate? Sure. Sure, why not. It's - *(exhale)* - it's a bit of a gamble, honestly. Aren't we all? Walk your voucher over to the booth, Yolanda will sort you out.
idle_chatter: Semi-permanent. That's the word. We COULD move. We just - *(exhale)* - haven't needed to.
Everything past the gate's extra. Sign says so. Nobody reads signs anymore.
dialogue.transaction: That's a Shady Loot Crate voucher, my friend. Take it over to the prize booth - Yolanda handles fulfillment, not me. I just sell the dream.
dialogue.farewell: Come back anytime. The tent's always fogged up and waiting.

special_triggers.beatdown_promo: You want to be on TELEVISION? Shady Productions, folding table's right behind the big top. The Bacchanus Beach Beatdown, Season 22. Walk the gear path down to Fauxst Beach on the Bohemian Riviera, tell 'em Vance sent you - *(exhale)* - not that it gets you anything. Just tell 'em anyway.
special_triggers.vance_met_first_time: Ringmaster Vance Vallaro. Circus proprietor, television producer, connoisseur of a good gamble - *(exhale)* - honestly, aren't we all?
special_triggers.loot_crate_voucher_sold: There she is. A bit of a gamble, honestly. Booth's that way.

services.description: Sells the Shady Loot Crate Voucher from his tent (variable price, per his own pitch). Vance hawks and sells the voucher here; fulfillment and crate contents belong to prize_booth, per canon (game_design_document.md: 'offers shady loot crates from the prize booth'). See cirque_du_shady_items.json for the voucher item and its redemption pointer.

schedule.absent_reason: N/A - always present during grounds hours

quest_connections.note: Vance advertises the show and points players toward Fauxst Beach on the Bohemian Riviera; he does not administer sign-up himself. The actual quest origin is Petra at signup_table (debaucheryville_riverfront_bohemian_riviera_01), per bacchanusbeachbeatdown.md and bohemian_riviera_location_nodes.json.

npcs.voice_direction: Sales patter with a vape-cloud-shaped pause built into every sentence's pacing, not layered on after. Never breaks the pride - he has never once questioned whether it was earned.

npcs.role: Normally stands as the knife-thrower's live target; on interactive rounds steps aside and coaches the player through the dodge minigame instead

appearance.clothing: sequined leotard gone matte with age

dialogue.greeting: You want my job? Fine. Stand there. Don't flinch - flinching is how you get hit. I flinch never.
idle_chatter: Eight thousand throws. Zero misses. He's better than the fax machine, and that's the highest compliment I hand out.
dialogue.transaction: N/A - Blanka does not sell anything; she gatekeeps the dodge round

special_triggers.dodge_round_handoff: Stand there. Don't flinch. I'll be over here, not flinching, the way I always do.

services.description: Free to attempt; tip solicited after via the tip jar beside the target board. Hands off her spot to the player for the knife_throw_dodge minigame. Full mechanical spec intentionally deferred - see interactions file mini_games.knife_throw_dodge.

schedule.present_hours: Cirque open hours, performance_circle, rotating schedule with Bobo's balloon-animal pitch
schedule.absent_reason: N/A - alternates with Bobo on a rotating schedule neither has formally agreed to

npcs.voice_direction: Dry, competent, deadpan - the tourists who volunteer for her spot alarm her more than the knives ever have.

npcs.full_name: Hamstradamus (no other name is known, on record, or asked for)
npcs.role: Prophecy Roulette / doom-prophet performer; Cirque du Shady's most beloved act
npcs.note: This entry is scoped to his Cirque du Shady prophecy-tent appearance only, mirroring how bohemian_riviera_npcs.json scopes his beach-podium appearance. Full appearance, personality, complete dialogue trees, and animation states are owned entirely by hamstradamus.md and are not restated here beyond what this location's Prophecy Roulette event needs.

appearance.build: round, well-fed hamster build, roughly 25-30cm standing
appearance.clothing: glittering, oversized turban (Cirque du Shady default look, distinct from his Fauxst Beach wizard-hat/speedo filming-day look)

personality.speech_pattern: carnival-barker prophet register, dead serious during prophecy delivery

dialogue.greeting: STEP FORWARD, MORTAL. FIVE COINS BUYS YOU THE TRUTH. THE TRUTH DOES NOT ACCEPT REFUNDS.
idle_chatter: GO. LIVE YOUR LIFE. IT WILL HAPPEN THE WAY I SAID REGARDLESS.
dialogue.transaction: THE BALL SEES ALL. THE BALL HAS SEEN YOUR FUTURE. THE BALL WOULD LIKE YOU TO SIT DOWN FOR THIS.
dialogue.farewell: GO. LIVE YOUR LIFE. IT WILL HAPPEN THE WAY I SAID REGARDLESS.

special_triggers.no_coins_decline: NO COINS, NO PROPHECY. THE UNIVERSE IS NOT FREE, THOUGH IT WOULD APPRECIATE BEING CONSULTED MORE OFTEN.
special_triggers.return_visit_callback: BACK AGAIN. GOOD. THE FIRST PROPHECY IS NEVER THE LAST ONE. THAT IS HOW PROPHECIES WORK.

beatdown_loss_tent_callback.line: HE WHO ENTERS THE BACCHANUS BEFORE HIS TIME SHALL NEVER GET THE BOOTH SEAT AGAIN, ONLY THE ONE BY THE BATHROOM. REPENT.
beatdown_loss_tent_callback.note: Not scripted in bacchanusbeachbeatdown.md - proposed only in hamstradamus.md as a prophecy-tent callback on the losing bro's next visit, matching the register of the canon-locked WIN line. Flagged here exactly as profile-proposed, per hamstradamus.md's own Development Notes; do not treat as established quest-doc canon.

services.description: Genuinely random. Random buff or debuff, delivered as an absurd, always-true doom prophecy. Full mechanics owned by hamstradamus.md; see interactions file events.prophecy_roulette for the grounds-level event hook.

schedule.absent_reason: Beatdown filming days only: physically relocated to the Fauxst Beach prize podium on the Bohemian Riviera as prize-giver (filming_day_active == true). Reverts to normal tent operation between filming blocks.

quest_connections.note: Primary quest role and full mechanics live at the Fauxst Beach prize_podium (bohemian_riviera_npcs.json); this tent appearance is his home-base residency between filming days.

npcs.voice_direction: Booming, cavernous, dead serious for the prophecy; ambient/idle tent chatter is warm showman patter, closer to a carnival barker's easy charm. Never winks at the audience - the character does not know it's funny.

overheard: I've got 47 tickets! What can I get?
Is that elephant... still in there? Since 1997?
The lady at the booth said 'everything else extra.' I thought that was a JOKE.

ambient_npcs.function: Density and reaction-shot dressing across the grounds; simplified sprites at distance, full detail near active attractions per cirque_du_shady.md Mobile Optimization notes.

npc_to_npc.description: Vance is the grounds' single point of contact and treats every walk-up as a potential talent discovery for Shady Productions; Yolanda handles his loot-crate voucher fulfillment at the prize booth with the same flat professionalism she brings to every other prize, visibly unthrilled to be doing his fulfillment on top of her own counter (per cirque_du_shady.md Economic Integration). Hamstradamus is Vance's most dependable act and, per hamstradamus.md, Vance is his employer running both the Cirque and, via Shady Productions, the Beatdown. Bobo is fellow Cirque performer, deeply insecure about Hamstradamus's genuine popularity next to his own failing act (per crypto_clown.md and hamstradamus.md, one-directional - Hamstradamus has no rivalry with Bobo and likely hasn't noticed there's supposed to be one). Blanka and Bobo share performance_circle on a rotating schedule neither has formally agreed to.
